review.title: Barley DT and Quinoa SCDY1: thirteen reference correspondences and three complete ambiguities
review.independence_basis: The full current records, retained primary identification and assay contexts, prior findings and actual historical guard scopes were read before staging. The parent independently read both complete actual M5 candidate diffs and rehashed their source inputs. The unchanged shared stage/apply/check/builder path was exercised through the completed Apple canary before these two units. This authored assessment is a partial technical diagnostic, not a new full scientific review.
review.summary: Two whole records now retain thirteen native species-reference GTDB correspondences, three complete ambiguity lists and sixteen selected grounding statuses. Barley's sixteen B-series isolates and Quinoa's nine species-like isolates, all original source and biological fields, native-null outcomes and unselected existing blocks remain unchanged. Each actual M5 application has two native inline events, one new native history sidecar and eight scoped native commands. Barley's reference-accession/timing findings and Quinoa's selected-excerpt, reciprocal-fitness and inherited Acidovorax-population limits remain explicit.
review.scope_description: Sixteen selected taxonomy descriptors' GTDB correspondence/status/options across two whole records, their source-stock versus reference-population boundaries, and actual application/history/check provenance. Existing scientific claims are preserved without a new approval judgment.
review.selection: CommunityMech:000428 and CommunityMech:000459 are the remaining two eligible units after the completed and separately saved Apple 377 canary. Apple is not reassessed by this bundle. Whole record 471 remains excluded and held under issues 2898 and 2899.
limitations: Partial technical diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Six authored assessments and sixteen required native checks do not constitute whole-record scientific approval, source-snippet certification, corpus QC or closure of prior findings.

Barley source coverage comprises retained Methods 2.2-2.6, Table 1 and host-assay context from PMID:42453107. The sixteen experimental B-series stocks were identified through partial 16S matches; source reference names and accessions are not newly classified study assemblies. No new sequence, figure, supplement or complete scientific audit was performed.

Barley indices 0,1,4,6,8,10,11,12,13,15 have reference populations 3,20,6,7,2,3,217,3,9,4 respectively. Fractions are 1.0 except rounded 0.85 at index 1 and 0.94 at index 11. The rounded fractions do not establish exact numerators, inoculum proportions or particular stock genomes. Indices 2 and 7 retain complete ordered three- and four-option ambiguity lists; no candidate is selected.

Barley B7 remains the experimental isolate; B8W22 is source reference information. The duplicate NR_133818.1 use for B6/B7 and NR_117748.1 use for B13/B14, and the Methods-versus-Results timing discrepancy, remain findings from the prior full review. Native species correspondence does not resolve these reference or experimental-timing issues. The four native-null descriptors at indices3,5,9,14 remain unchanged.

Barley retains two nodes and zero arrows, the barley versus wheat/WCS417r/challenge distinctions, the host disease endpoint and the limitations of OTU-based persistence. No member-level mechanism, reciprocal microbial benefit or viable stock persistence is newly inferred.

Quinoa source coverage is all retained selected preprint excerpts for doi:10.64898/2026.07.15.738596, not newly retrieved full text or supplements. Preserve the historical independent-abstract checks separately. Nine partial 16S species-like isolates came from a quinoa-associated collection and were tested in Arabidopsis; host, source and screening contexts remain distinct.

Quinoa selected indices 0,2,6 retain reference populations 5,9,127 with fraction 1.0. Index 7 retains all four ordered Priestia/Virgibacillus alternatives without a selected species. Native-null index 1 and four existing blocks at indices 3,4,5,8 remain unchanged. The stored Acidovorax population 375 differs from the fresh diagnostic 324 and is neither refreshed nor certified in this add-only scope.

Quinoa retains one host-benefit node, zero causal arrows, no growth_media and its strongest 120 mM versus 100 mM screening distinction. Historical issue 1747 source/reciprocal-fitness limits and the missing-access caveat remain; no new live issue-status assertion is made.

GTDB label suffixes and Rhodococcoides/Rhodococcus correspondence record native database differences, not formal nomenclatural rulings or source-stock reidentifications. Crosswalk SHA256 761d5537 identifies exact bytes; upstream release and chronology are unestablished, and mapping_source describes file mtime only. Local NCBI authority observations use file-stat provenance, not a full database hash or release certification.

Actual M5 staging, applications and all sixteen native checks ran at 24f0185a869377f74ecad1425756cb5413d9aa72 with Python 3.13.2. Local preparation used Python 3.13.12 and its separately recorded revision. The saved assessment preserves actual execution bindings rather than relabeling them to later local commits.

Each unit's eight required commands comprise native history scaffolding and seven scoped validators. Strict successor admission, preserved historical caller predicates, source-snippet comparisons, generated products and combined QC remain separate. Batch 92 must preserve existing 424 and 361 admissions while adding only 459; batch 7's immutable Barley decision remains unchanged. Record 471 identity and mechanistic findings remain outside this bundle.
